Sep - 2016 that you have not yet updated your iCloud ID information.', 'Our online services was recently upgraded to add our new security features and for a better user friendly online experience.However a full upgrade of your account was not successful due to various technical issues.', 'This e-mail is to congratulate you as your email address have won you a cash prize of 715,000.00 in our Online Lottery Sweepstakes Promotion held in London NOV 2011.', 'But we have held it for the moment because the amount is over the security borders of our rules.', 'An error was detected on your online banking details.', 'We detected irregular activity on your HSBC Internet banking account on 27/05/2010.', 'Your account has open issues : Click to Resolve', 'Your company or your personal E-mail address, attached to winning number 23-76-06-54-42-100, with Serial number 647489, consequently won in the Tenth lottery category.', 'our records indicate that your account was Flagged and has upshot an internal error on our processor.', 'We have temporarily suspended your online service', 'This message confirms your NatWest Secure password has changed on Tue, Nov 5, 2013 17:09:45(GMT).']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
